title: Recipes for Successful Transfer Learning for Neural Network Analysis of High-Resolution Transmission Electron Microscopy Data
content: Modern machine learning techniques applied to electron microscopy promise to accelerate, improve, and expand our materials characterization capabilities. However, finding the right combinations of model frameworks, algorithmic and computational advances, and training data to solve new problems and develop new methods in characterization and microscopy can be challenging. Importantly, high quality, well-annotated electron microscopy data are scarce, imposing a significant barrier to the development and use of machine learning models.
